vedic_reference.note: The name Satya is derived from the Sanskrit word सत्यम् (satyam), which means truth. In Hinduism, Satya is considered a divine attribute and is often associated with the gods Vishnu and Indra. It is also the name of a Vedic goddess, Satya Devi, who is believed to protect the truth.
